notes: V5.2.107 — What's included: Gaming Mode in AI Optimize for invited accounts. A Gaming Mode switch sits under your PC temperatures and shows your active game, background apps (including your Discord call) and your music with pause and play. It has an FPS counter you can turn on. When Call of Duty is running with Gaming Mode on, Opti Gods checks the Call of Duty tweaks, NVIDIA MSI High priority, the NVIDIA Control Panel preset and your PC's matched tweaks, and applies any that are missing in a normal tweak run. Call of Duty installed through Battle.net is now detected. Game IFEO priority tweaks (Call of Duty, Fortnite and other games) now always use High, never Realtime. Also: the admin Perf Recorder no longer lists tweaks that don't apply to your PC. RTX-only tweaks (RTX 50-series, RTX 5060, RTX Video) are skipped on GTX cards, the VRAM segment tweak is skipped on PCs with a separate graphics card, and NVIDIA capture tweaks (Ansel, NVIDIA App telemetry) are no longer counted because Full Optimize never applies them. The DirectX graphics setting is checked correctly when Windows stores other settings beside it, and the FiveM I/O priority no longer shows as missing because two FiveM tweaks set it differently. FiveM High Priority now always uses High, never Realtime. Copy missing now shows what your PC has for each value. Also fixes the V5.2.106 build (FiveM ReShade one-click). V5.2.106 — What's included: FiveM ReShade in one click (admin test first): installs ReShade with the Opti Gods look and the Opti Gods overlay into FiveM, with options to hide the logo or the optigods.com banner and pick where the banner sits. FiveM must be closed; any ReShade you already had is backed up and put back if you remove it. V5.2.105 — Gaming Mode now sees Twitch, Kick and YouTube open in a browser window on any monitor and keeps that browser at full speed so the video stays smooth while your game stays on High. When OBS or Streamlabs is live, Gaming Mode shows LIVE with your profile picture and the platform (Twitch, Kick or YouTube); OBS and Streamlabs are never changed. The Dashboard shows the green Optimized button and 100% when every tweak is confirmed, even if a later small run had a failure. V5.2.104 — Counter-Strike 2 profile fixed for PCs where Steam remembers a drive that no longer exists (the "Cannot find drive D" error). If Counter-Strike 2 is installed it now shows in the missing tweaks button; if it is not installed, Full Optimize skips it with a clear note instead of failing. Full Optimize lists it as Counter-Strike 2. The update screen text is now red. V5.2.103 — AI Optimize has a search bar for its tweak list. AI Optimize and the Dashboard now count confirmed tweaks the same way, so both show the same number. Smart State Detection and Optimization Level on the Dashboard show that same confirmed count instead of an old local number. The Music card explains that Now Playing works with or without a game. Admin revenue shows Stripe payments and the CashApp/PayPal log separately. V5.2.101 — Gaming Mode shows if you are tabbed in or out of your game: the game card glows red with a TABBED IN label while the game is in front, and looks normal with TABBED OUT when you switch away. The update screen text is now black so it is easy to read on the splash. Revenue editing in the admin panel now shows a clear error instead of silently resetting. V5.2.99 — The tweak audit no longer lists tweaks as missing when they are applied: mouse and desktop settings saved as text, the classic right-click menu, and tweaks that share a setting now read correctly. The copied .reg file now matches Windows formats. V5.2.98 — The update screen now plays the same red Opti Gods spinning splash you see when the app opens. V5.2.97 — Fixed the NVIDIA preset showing as missing when it is applied. The FPS counter now starts instantly without asking to download again, stays on next time you open Opti Gods, and retries by itself if it fails to start. Added play, pause and skip buttons for your music. Added Discord voice call detection with your profile picture, and Discord gets extra priority during calls. Added cover art for the Microsoft Store SoundCloud app. Fixed closed apps like Brave staying in the Gaming Mode list. Gaming Mode's background service now updates itself with the app. V5.2.94 — Download and install updates in one click: the installer downloads, is checked against the release, opens by itself and plays the success chime. Signed releases can update and reopen Opti Gods automatically. The update popup shows the real notes for the new version. Gaming Mode shows FiveM by name with your server or main menu, browser tab counts and what is being optimized. The NVIDIA preset no longer shows as missing just because NVIDIA could not be read at startup. V5.2.91 — Fixed live game detection and the FPS counter (Windows telemetry no longer fails with "filename too long"). Now Playing with cover art, and instant music play/pause detection for Gaming Mode. Gaming Mode can now adjust Brave/Chrome tab processes and lists every background app it found. V5.2.90 — Live monitor keeps FPS, temperatures and CPU/GPU/RAM load updating every second while you are in the game, and follows FiveM when it restarts its game process. Red Opti Gods text on the startup splash. V5.2.89 — Gaming Mode now detects Spotify, SoundCloud and browser music while you game: playing audio stays at full speed, other background apps get efficiency mode and low memory priority. Tweak success now always shows the green popup, chime and restart reminder. Admin Gaming Mode test switch in the Performance Recorder (keeps the running game at High priority and lowers background apps, stays on after closing Opti Gods). Recordings save to Downloads automatically. CPU sensor button no longer fails when the driver is already installed. Performance Recorder works with any game: detects games from the built-in library, any game installed in Steam/Epic/Riot/EA/Ubisoft/GOG/Xbox folders, or the app using the GPU, and shows the right cover or the game's own icon (fixes the missing Fortnite logo). Fixes the FPS tile showing "No frames" (PresentMon frame column was not read) and adds clear feedback when the FPS counter downloads and starts. FiveM server box no longer shows "mumble" from voice chat; known servers are named automatically and a pencil lets you set your own name. Tweak audit now reads every registry value each tweak sets and shows applied or missing with the current and needed value, includes the detected game's own tweaks, and can copy missing values as a .reg file. Nothing is written by the audit.
